calibration_admission_rule.note: calibration replaces RAW for a fold only if all gates pass on training history
calibration_admission_rule.pathology: SIGMOID needs finite params and positive coefficient; ISOTONIC needs outer exact-0/1 fraction <= 0.5

calibration_fit: outer TRAIN history only: inner-OOS predictions of the selected config; earlier inner fold(s) fit calibrator, later inner fold evaluates; final calibrator refit on pooled inner-OOS; applied to outer validation once; in-sample predictions never used as OOS evidence

calibration_layout.D1: one inner fold only: no fit/select split possible, CALIBRATION_NOT_EVALUABLE, RAW
calibration_layout.D2: fit on D2-I1 OOS, select on D2-I2 OOS, refit pooled I1+I2
calibration_layout.D3: fit on pooled D3-I1+I2 OOS, select on D3-I3 OOS, refit pooled I1+I2+I3

calibration_scope: per threshold; one common method preferred; never mixed on outer-validation evidence
compute_budget: 96 inner + 12 outer binary fits; calibration is transforms only; no search expansion

control.scope: four independent binary models, one per threshold; frozen, never tuned or retrained for selection

d_anchor.note: D-selected on every outer fold; HGB closed, never reopened

final_calibration_rule: RAW unless the same non-RAW method is admitted on every evaluable fold for a threshold; per-threshold methods recorded in the recipe; MIXED/UNSTABLE stability forces RAW
final_config_rule: majority vote across D1/D2/D3 selected configs; ties broken by preregistered order X0<X2<X1<X3; an X0 win means refinement added nothing over the anchor
finalist_rule: at most ONE nonlinear final recipe; no ensemble; poor F never reselects (no-reselection rule)
firewall_2025: NONE (dev seasons 2018-2024 only + tripwire + ProtectedHoldoutError; no 2025 targets, predictions, prevalence, metrics, calibration, or selection)

fit_budget.note: 6 inner folds (1+2+3) x 4 cfg x 4 thr; 3 outer x 4 thr; calibration reuses inner OOS

primary_metric: mean_race_macro_log_loss_over_4_thresholds; authoritative: candidate PROJECTED minus Logistic PROJECTED; lower better
refinement_scope: tree count / learning rate / regularization only; no max_depth search; no new families; no blending
stage_analysis: frozen EARLY/MID/LATE via stages.stage_partition; descriptive only; no stage-based tuning

temporal_selection.mechanism: frozen M6 expanding-window inner splits (inner_splits.resolve_inner_splits), outer TRAIN history only
temporal_selection.score: mean over inner folds of [mean over 4 thresholds of race-macro LL], per outer fold
temporal_selection.shared_config: ONE XGB configuration shared across all four thresholds (no per-threshold selection)
temporal_selection.tie_break: differences <= 1e-6 prefer X0 anchor, then lower-complexity (300-tree before 500-tree), then preregistered order X0<X2<X1<X3

top1_guard: top1 is a required safety/quality diagnostic reported per fold and pooled; broad/material top1 regression forbids KEEP_PERFORMANCE_CANDIDATE but may permit KEEP_DIVERSITY_CANDIDATE with explicit statement; top1 never overrides the primary metric
transformation_order: RAW model probabilities -> optional threshold calibration -> PAVA coherence projection -> PROJECTED_COHERENT output
